page.title: Dual Eligible & Medicaid Plans (D-SNP) | AltaMedicare
page.description: If you have both Medicare and Medicaid, D-SNP plans offer extra benefits: grocery cards, transportation, OTC, dental, vision, and $0 premiums.

header.lede: If you have both Medicare and Medicaid, you may qualify for special plans with extra benefits at little to no cost.

basics.textHtml: If you qualify for both Medicare and Medicaid, you’re considered dual eligible. Special plans called D-SNPs (Dual-Eligible Special Needs Plans) are designed specifically for people in your situation — with extra benefits beyond what either program offers alone.

cards.d: monthly allowance for healthy groceries at participating stores
allowance for pharmacy items like vitamins, pain relievers, first aid
rides to medical appointments and sometimes to the pharmacy or grocery store
often more generous than standard Medicare Advantage plans

qualify.introHtml: You may be dual eligible if you’re on Medicare AND any of the following:
qualify.noteHtml: Income and asset limits apply. We can help you check whether you qualify and walk through the application if you’re close.

switch.textHtml: Most Medicare beneficiaries are locked into their plan choice except during certain enrollment windows. Dual-eligible beneficiaries get a Special Enrollment Period that lets them change D-SNP plans more flexibly throughout the year.

help.heading: Not sure if you qualify?
help.textHtml: Call us. We’ll check Medicare and Medicaid eligibility together — it’s a quick conversation, and many people find out they qualify for benefits they didn’t know about.

cta.textHtml: One free, no-pressure call — clear answers, no sales pitch.
